config_template:
[query]
tenant_id = "default"
cluster_id = "clickbench"
{users}
[storage]
type = "fs"
allow_insecure = true

[storage.fs]
data_path = "{vd}/_data"

[meta]
endpoints = ["127.0.0.1:9191"]
username = "root"
password = "root"
client_timeout_in_second = 60
auto_sync_interval = 60

[log.file]
dir = "{vd}/logs"
query_client: HTTP POST /v1/query, wait_time_secs=30, max_rows_per_page=100000, client-side wall time

v0.9.53.source: official release v0.9.53-nightly (the version ClickBench uses)

v1.2.955.source: official release v1.2.955-nightly, commit 058a1e8fbd, before encoded columns #20819

official-967.source: commit 25ca45599d (= v1.2.967) built locally by build-official.sh with the release CI parameters; meta from the v1.2.967 package

build_info.name: official-967
build_info.git_log:
25ca45599d feat(query): improve bloom runtime filter selection and sampling (#20847)
f526ce0d9c refactor(query): plan runtime filters with filter push-down rules (#20870)
8812710fe6 fix: report table-meta-inspector failures (#21127)
9433cf82aa fix(query): preserve RBAC upgrade compatibility and audit access (#21132)
a83eaeaddd feat(query): speed up top COUNT(*) GROUP BY queries by aggregating only heavy hitter keys (#21077)
dea33860c3 fix(query): batch small blocks before the window partition exchange (#21112)
76caf9e844 fix(query): enforce stage WRITE on HTTP uploads (#21126)
10a03cc83e feat: config: add `ownership` to `cache.meta_service_caches` (#21124)
ad64c4c815 feat(storage): partial column update(read path) (#21098)
1d54ffea64 chore: meta: use sub-cache 0.4.1, which stops a dropped cache's watch (#21123)
6546196f60 feat(query): read the watched user on MySQL and FlightSQL login (#21110)
50f8ae1bf3 fix(query): stream all-pairs joins with bounded memory (#20966)
build_info.rustc:
rustc 1.101.0-nightly (12433c307 2026-10-24)
binary: rustc
commit-hash: 12433c307b5a497388ffe2f4e49dbf1ab8c71fa0
commit-date: 2026-10-24
host: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
release: 1.101.0-nightly
LLVM version: 23.1.4
build_info.cargo_cmd: cargo build --locked --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --features default --profile release --bin databend-query
build_info.profile_release:
[profile.release]
debug = "line-tables-only"
lto = "thin"
overflow-checks = false
opt-level = "s"            # defaults to be 3
incremental = false
codegen-units = 1          ## better performance see below comment
build_info.cargo_config:
[env]
# https://android.googlesource.com/platform/external/jemalloc_new/+/refs/heads/master/TUNING.md
JEMALLOC_SYS_WITH_MALLOC_CONF = "percpu_arena:percpu,oversize_threshold:0,background_thread:true,dirty_decay_ms:5000,muzzy_decay_ms:5000"

## If you are using aarch64-apple-darwin, you may need to set the following:
## JEMALLOC_SYS_WITH_LG_PAGE = "14"
## JEMALLOC_SYS_WITH_MALLOC_CONF = "oversize_threshold:0,dirty_decay_ms:5000,muzzy_decay_ms:5000"

[target.'cfg(target_os = "linux")']
linker = "clang"
rustflags = ["-C", "link-arg=-fuse-ld=mold", "-C", "link-arg=-flto=thin"]

a85e50302c fix(query): probe the partition built in each hash join spill round (#21141)
